related.note: Both describe the tall whites' 'high-speed horse formation', in which merging force fields look like one large white shape at Indian Springs in 1965-67. Here the formation joins fields to make a single larger craft, where the story says it is suits merging.

plain: Charles Hall says that between 1965 and 1967, in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, he watched pale beings he calls the Tall Whites. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that one of them, whom he calls Range Four Harry, flew craft in what Hall calls a "high-speed horse formation," and that the craft merged their fields to form a single larger craft. If true, it would mean these craft could join together in flight.
